title: A/B Testing Framework for Berlin Rent Policy
methodology: Two-sample z-test, two-sided. MDE = (Z_α/2 + Z_β)·√(2σ²/n) with α=0.05 (Z=1.96), power=0.8 (Z=0.84), σ=€3.27/m² (Immoscout grid std), n=361 cleaned grid cells.

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect for Berlin (σ=€3.27/m², n=361 grid cells)
mde.interpretation: Can detect a €0.68/m² rent change (5.6% of Berlin avg €12.07) with 80% power at α=0.05

scenarios.hypothesis: H₀: No change vs H₁: μ_after > μ_before
H₀: No change vs H₁: μ_after > μ_before

counterfactuals.name: If Berlin rents reached Munich levels
